text:
Anya Patel: heads up — onboarding 7B-committed model from HF. generation_config.json had repetition_penalty: 1.2 but outputs still loop on repeated phrases.
Liam Chen: did you map HF keys -> Redwood defaults or just drop the file? sometimes we ignore fields if do_sample=false
Anya Patel: we pass the gen config through a translator that picks allowed keys. do_sample was true. Temperature from HF was 0.7, Redwood console shows 0.8 applied.
Marco Rivera: common gotcha: HF uses tokenizer special tokens (e.g. <|endoftext|> or </s>) that affect stopping. If the chat template injects role tokens, effective context changes sampling behavior.
Sofia Alvarez: also watch for no_repeat_ngram_size vs repetition_penalty. Redwood default maps no_repeat_ngram -> token ngram filter and uses rep_penalty only if explicitly set.
Liam Chen: quick mapping snippet i used earlier:
```
// HF -> Redwood minimal mapping
{ "do_sample": "sampler.enabled", "temperature": "sampler.temp", "top_k": "sampler.top_k", "top_p": "sampler.top_p", "repetition_penalty": "sampler.rep_penalty" }
```
Liam Chen: but note: if top_k is 0 or null HF treats as disabled, we set top_k=50 fallback to avoid degenerate softmax tails.
Anya Patel: good call. We saw deterministic repeats when top_k ended up 0 after some conversion edge case.
Marco Rivera: another subtle one — HF sometimes saves "penalty_alpha" for contrastive decoding; Redwood doesn't support it yet so it gets dropped which can increase repetition in some seq2seqs.
Sofia Alvarez: quantization note: INT4/INT8 EVP runs can change sample logits ordering slightly, making the same gen_config produce different repetitiveness. Seen this on fp16->int8 conversion tests.
Anya Patel: infra question — is it expected that console shows 0.8 temp when we submitted 0.7? or is that rounding/display bug?
InfraBot: deploy-notify: model-loader v2.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-09T14:12:30Z (build b3f8). Logs: "gen-config-normalizer applied defaults: temp=0.8 top_k=50" :information_source:
Liam Chen: that clarifies it — normalizer enforces min_temp=0.8 for that model family. It's a policy to reduce degenerate low-temp sampling observed in earlier runs.
Anya Patel: ok will update the onboarding checklist. action items: 1) explicitly set repetition_penalty in gen_config, 2) ensure top_k != null, 3) add stop tokens aligned with tokenizer.special_tokens, 4) record precision (fp16/int8) used in perf tests.
Sofia Alvarez: adding: capture a small eval prompt set to detect repetition regressions automatically. If rep_penalty not honored, fail the bring-up.
Liam Chen: i'll add a tiny transformer in the converter to transform HF's "no_repeat_ngram_size" -> Redwood "sampler.no_repeat_ngram" to keep behavior parity.
Anya Patel: thanks — will run quantized smoke tests after that change and paste results here. :thumbsup:
